name: Electrex Inc
old_description: As a leader in electrical system solutions since 1977, Electrex Inc has a wealth of knowledge and experience in everything related to the manufacturing of wire harnesses, battery cables, and electrical panels.
about:
Electrex Inc operates from Hutchinson, Kansas, where it was founded in 1949. The company has grown into an international provider of electrical system solutions, though details of its founding ownership or early history are not publicly disclosed.

The company designs and builds wire harnesses, battery cables, and electrical panels. Its production relies on fully automated lines, ultrasonic welding, and lean manufacturing practices, with every harness receiving a 100% electrical continuity test to IPC/WHM-A-620 standards. Electrex runs multiple manufacturing facilities and offers technical re-engineering services to reduce cost and update components.

Electrex serves the turf, recreation, construction, public utilities, and agriculture sectors. Long-standing clients include Excel Industries (Hustler Mowers & Big Dog Mowers), a zero-turn mower manufacturer partnered for over 40 years, and Charles Machine Works (Ditch Witch), an underground construction equipment maker partnered for nearly four decades. Altec, a provider to electric utility and telecommunications markets, is a newer account.

The company describes itself as a values-driven Capital III organization guided by Character, Connection, Competence, and Commitment. It emphasizes worldwide shipping from a central U.S. location, high-run discounts from multiple plants, personalized single-point-of-contact service, and a focus on speed to production through automation and just-in-time capability.
